role: United Nations member states ratifying the BBNJ Agreement
promise: Bring the BBNJ Agreement into force 120 days after the sixtieth ratification
description: The agreement was adopted June 19, 2023. The sixtieth ratification on September 19, 2025 triggered entry into force on January 17, 2026.
evidence: The UN records entry into force on January 17, 2026.
